methods.name: check
methods.docs: Run all the integrity checks and return the detailed report.

properties.name: rooted
properties.docs: The device is rooted (Android) or jailbroken (iOS).

properties.name: hooked
properties.docs: An instrumentation or hooking framework (Frida, Xposed, Substrate...) is loaded in the app process.

properties.name: debugged
properties.docs: A debugger is attached to the app process. Expected to be true on development builds.

properties.name: reasons
properties.docs: Identifiers of the checks that detected something, for logging purposes.

properties.name: failedChecks
properties.docs: Identifiers of the checks that could not run. A non-empty list means the report is incomplete.
